title: Correct AnnounceMessage originator IID documentation to key-derived identity
description: P4 protocol documentation correctness: python/src/lichen/announce/messages.py still documents originator_iid as EUI-64-derived, while the implemented and normative identity profile derives the IID from SHA-512(Ed25519 pubkey) with the U/L bit cleared and explicitly quarantines EUI helpers to link interoperability. Update the source API documentation so callers are not directed toward a noncanonical identity model.
